test_bool_from_request: test bool_from_request parses string params like 'True', 'Yes', '1' into booleans and raises on invalid input
test_int_from_request: test int_from_request parses string params like '0', '1', '10' into integers and raises ValidationError on invalid input
test_validate_upload_url: test validate_upload_url blocks local and private IP URLs when block_local_urls is true and rejects non-http schemes
test_string_is_url: test string_is_url returns True for http and https URLs and False for non-URL strings
test_get_client_ip: test get_client_ip extracts client IP from HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR or REMOTE_ADDR headers
